channels_serial_side.name: SIN
channels_serial_side.purpose: Serial data input from peripheral or modem; idle HIGH; receiver samples mid-bit.

channels_serial_side.name: SOUT
channels_serial_side.purpose: Serial data output to peripheral or modem; idle HIGH (mark).

channels_modem_handshake.name: CTS
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: Clear To Send (active LOW); modem status; software interprets, not gating TX hardware.

channels_modem_handshake.name: RTS
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: Request To Send (active LOW); driven by MCR.1.

channels_modem_handshake.name: DSR
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: Data Set Ready (active LOW); modem status.

channels_modem_handshake.name: DTR
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: Data Terminal Ready (active LOW); driven by MCR.0.

channels_modem_handshake.name: DCD
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: Data Carrier Detect (active LOW); modem status.

channels_modem_handshake.name: OUT1
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: User-defined output (active LOW); driven by MCR.2.

channels_modem_handshake.name: OUT2
channels_modem_handshake.purpose: User-defined output (active LOW); driven by MCR.3.

channels_dma_handshake.name: TXRDY
channels_dma_handshake.purpose: TX FIFO/THR ready; Mode 0 = THR empty; Mode 1 = FIFO empty (selected by FCR.3).

channels_dma_handshake.name: RXRDY
channels_dma_handshake.purpose: RX FIFO/RBR has data; Mode 0 = data available; Mode 1 = FIFO at trigger level.

channels_cpu_bus.name: RD
channels_cpu_bus.purpose: Read strobe (either RD HIGH or RD LOW with CS active enables read).

channels_cpu_bus.name: ADS
channels_cpu_bus.purpose: Address strobe; positive edge latches A0-A2 + CS0-CS2; tie LOW if unused.

channels_cpu_bus.name: DDIS
channels_cpu_bus.purpose: Driver Disable; LOW while CPU reads UART (for external bus transceiver).

channels_clock_reset.name: XOUT
channels_clock_reset.purpose: Crystal feedback inverter output; unused if external clock applied.

channels_clock_reset.name: BAUDOUT
channels_clock_reset.purpose: 16× baud-rate clock; tie to RCLK or external use.

dependency_graph.common_rule: TX and RX paths are independent (full duplex). Master Reset gates all output activity. Baud generator drives both TX and RX at 16× the bit rate.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Transmitter shifts on each /16 BAUDOUT edge. Receiver samples mid-bit on the 8th of every 16 BAUDOUT edges.

ordering_rules.register_ordering: DLAB must be set/cleared correctly to select between (RBR/THR/IER) and (DLL/DLM) views.
